Title: Failed-login threshold: 3 attempts
Preconditions: Existing test account is unlocked; failed-attempt state reset
Input: Incorrect password three times consecutively, then correct credentials
Steps: Submit incorrect password three times; try correct credentials immediately
ExpectedResult: Account is locked after the third consecutive failure; correct credentials are rejected during the lock period
ActualResult: The first two wrong-password requests returned HTTP 401 and raised login_attempts from 0 to 4 (two per request). The third wrong-password request and fourth request with the correct password returned HTTP 403 because the account was already locked after attempt 2.
Notes: Screenshot is saved. Read-only DB query after execution showed login_attempts=4 and locked_until=2026-10-14T09:26:00.071Z. The 403 responses indicate the account was locked before the third failed attempt.

Title: Backend does not trust client-supplied total
Preconditions: Signed in with the same test account; two-item web cart has expected total E=58,000,000 VND; record order-history baseline
Input: Set the editable Checkout total to E-1 = 57,999,999 VND; leave coupon blank
Steps: Open Checkout; set total to 57999999; open DevTools Network and clear the log; click Confirm Payment once; inspect POST /api/checkout request and response for submitted total and orderId; open Profile/order history and compare the new stored order total with E
ExpectedResult: Backend recalculates the amount as E=58,000,000 VND from the cart and does not persist the client-supplied E-1
ActualResult: Checkout returned HTTP 200. After checkout, Profile order history showed order #1 with total 57,999,999 VND, matching the submitted client value E-1 rather than the cart total E=58,000,000 VND.
